name: folder-index
title: Run audit over folder IDs
description: Runs a declared direct-folder audit over all or selected paths in a saved folder index with bounded results and supervised time limits.

settings.name: folder_paths
settings.title: Selected indexed folder paths
settings.description: Optional JSON array, e.g. ["src/components", "src/pages"]. Exact paths relative to this index root; use "." for root. Omit for all indexed folders. Empty arrays are rejected. Children are not implicitly selected.
